css.description: Full contents of the project's globals.css (or any CSS holding the design tokens / CSS custom properties). Optional when `sources` is given.

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to return. Truncates the token sheet to fit.

name.description: Optional label for the extracted system, e.g. the app or repo name.

sources.description: Any mix of brand sources, merged in order (later sources win). See the tool description for how to gather each kind.

kind.description: Omit to infer: JSON with $value entries is tokens, JSON keyed by UI roles is computed, anything else is CSS.

name.description: Label for this source, e.g. 'globals.css', 'live site sample', 'figma variables'.

name: extract-design-system
title: Extract Design System From Existing Code
